title: Chapter 423
paragraphs: Chapter 423
123. All of a sudden?(1)
"Hey, hey, baldy. Do you know what this is? Huh?"
Murakan was shaking Picon, who was possessing the empty body of Brangsch, and asked.
Jin had left the imperial palace and was with Murakan and Gilly, searching for the territory of Volta.
After hearing that Kinzello, the leader, had the ability to manipulate 'iron' like a blacksmith god, Picon had asked to obtain a piece of it.
Fortunately, after Kinzello and his group had retreated, the iron formed by his power still remained on the battlefield.
Most of the iron was retrieved by Hyran and sent to the magicians for research, and Jin also brought some with him.
[You impatient guy, do you think analyzing ends as soon as you see it with your eyes? We need time to analyze.]
"How long does it take?"
[At least a week, if it's short.]
"Can't it be faster?"

[A week is already very fast. If we're unlucky, it could take several months, and we might not even gain anything. Don't think it's easy to find out the user's information with just a piece of iron like this.]
"Ha! Who the hell is that guy?"
Kinzello, the leader.
After this battle, two things were certain about him. First, he was a demon, and second, he possessed incredible power.
[You said he was a demon with enough power to overwhelm a 10-star knight and you? If he's that powerful, there must be unique magic left in the iron, so just wait patiently.]
"Alright, alright."
[By the way, what are you planning to do with the remaining iron pieces?]
Picon pointed at the remaining iron pieces in Jin's hand.
"I'm going to give them to Aria Hister."
[You mean that record mage. Good idea, she might be able to provide more information than me.]
Valeria was currently spending the busiest days among Jin's colleagues.
She was tracking down Hister's lost magic, restoring the record devices given to her by Jin, and even searching for Temar's tomb alone.
'I hope we can meet soon, but she must be incredibly busy. I should send it in a letter. And I should also prepare a gift for the emperor.'
The gold crown bestowed by the emperor as a reward had already arrived at the Sword Garden through the teleportation gate.
A reciprocal gift was needed for him.
'Mine corpse.'
Rik Helter, the 5th squad leader of the Royal Guard, and his subordinates, who Jin encountered in the Wanta Lamot Forest.
After choosing to become mines, they thought their bodies would oxidize without a trace. But Valeria's ice-sealing had left some evidence of the corpses.
Jin planned to reveal it to the public soon.
'From the conversations I've had, the Emperor seems ready to abandon Hyeran. It seemed like he wanted to get rid of Hyeran as soon as the stone was retrieved.'
So, Kinzello evaded the issue, and even though the royal court subtly pressured Hyeran, they didn't help Hyeran.

'Sending the Dragon Knights at the last minute must have been an unavoidable choice for the sake of the royal court's authority and to find the whereabouts of the stone. The Emperor probably hoped that Hyeran would be destroyed at that time.'
The Emperor wanted a more obedient Hyeran instead of the 'arrogant and uncontrollable' Ron Hyeran.
Losing Ron Hyeran, the strongest knight of Bimant, and his grandson Dante, who was designated as the next strongest, was undoubtedly a painful loss.
'However, since the existence of the Mine, it's no longer an irreplaceable force. The Emperor judged the threat of Ron and Dante to the royal court as a bigger problem.'
-Physical transformation? Like a biological golem?
-Similar but slightly different. Ancient dark magicians called it Mine transformation. It's not a perfect magic circle.
-It looks like that to me too. The activation is slow, and it looks unnecessarily complex and crude at first glance.
The conversation between Valeria and Jin in the Wantalaramo Forest about the Mine revealed that the current Bimant Mine was not complete.
Nevertheless, the Emperor believed that the loss of Ron and Dante could be sufficiently compensated by the Mine.
'Anyway, just like when the issue of Zipel's biological golem surfaced, I can give the royal court an irreversible image loss.'
After the terror incident, the royal court seemed to be siding with Kinzello instead of Hyeran.
However, not all people were fools, and rumors circulated that the royal court was trying to abandon Hyeran despite media manipulation and control.
Hyeran and Jin's supporters constantly released such articles as well.
The people of Bimant were most enraged by this process.
Biological golems and giant magical creatures that seem to obey human commands.
Especially after the holy nation incident, most ordinary people shuddered at the mention of 'biological golems.'
Jin publicly revealed how cruel and brutal the process of creating biological golems was.
"Hey, kid. What are you thinking?"
"I'm thinking that the public can't distinguish between Mine and biological golems."
"Uh? What are you talking about all of a sudden?"
"I'm going to release an article claiming that the Mine corpse we obtained from Wantalaramo Forest is not Kinzello's, but the royal court's biological golem."
"Sir, is that okay?"

"It's manipulated information, but I need to stop the royal court from cutting off Hyeran faster than I expected. The biological golem controversy is fatal, so they won't be able to properly touch Hyeran while trying to explain and cover it up."
The moment articles and evidence about the 'royal court's biological golem' began to circulate, the royal court would have to pay the price, including the subtle discouragement of Kinzello.

It would also inevitably draw a clear line with Kinzello. If they continued to show ambiguous attitudes, they might end up being accused of the biological golem that initially attacked Hyeran as 'royal court property.'
In that case, the royal court would appear to have failed in their attempt to purge Bimant's top family without any justification, in collusion with the terrorist forces.
Upon listening, it seems that way. The emperor didn't know that you had the Mine corpse, right?"
"Yeah, he didn't know. That's why I could act so boldly. If he knew, he would have had no choice but to propose a deal to me. I wouldn't have accepted it, though. Dino will be busy for a while."
Jin imagined the emperor's face and smiled. He was curious about the expression the emperor would make when the news about the Mine corpse hit the entire Bemonte.

"If you were born when your father was not around, Ron Hyran would have been an unbeatable person who could have gotten the title of the strongest. Compared to Shiron Lun Kandel, there is no such thing as neglect."
Murakan shrugged his shoulders.
"Anyway, Picon, we'll be going now. Please contact us as soon as you find any clues after the analysis is done."
[Understood.]
As soon as they arrived in the city of Calon through the teleportation gate, the party was surprised by an unexpected welcome and cheers.
"Wow!"
"The hero of the Hyran crisis!"
"A knight recognized by the Sword Emperor!"
"The great Black Dragon!"
It seemed like tens of thousands of residents welcomed the party. They had all been staying near the teleportation gate for several days, waiting for Jin to arrive.
Jin had stayed in the Sword Emperor's Castle until just before, and immediately returned after visiting the Imperial Palace, so he hadn't realized.

The outside world was already praising Jin as the hero of the Sword Emperor's Castle terror. The martial prowess that Jin and Murakan showed that day was spreading throughout the continent, including Hufester.
Of course, there were many other warriors who performed remarkably that day, but it was natural that Jin and Murakan stood out.
Murakan completely dyed the sky with his aura to protect the Sword Emperor's Castle, and Jin fought side by side with the Sword Emperor at the forefront.
Among the saints, there was even talk that the Sword Emperor's Castle would have been doomed that day if it weren't for Jin and Murakan.
"Black Dragon, please look this way just once!"
Of course, they wouldn't normally dare to cause such a commotion in the streets of Calon.
Especially since the teleportation gate was a space used for missions, it was usually maintained in an orderly state.
And it was impossible for people to gather to welcome the notorious 12th class.
Nevertheless, the fact that the residents could gather and noisily welcome the 12th class was the result of gaining '10%' of supporters after the declaration of the head of the family.
"What's that?"
Murakan, whose tone was rude but not too bothered by the cheering human voices, said,
"It seems they are people who support you, young master."
"Is it such a big deal that I, the Strawberry Pie, helped the Sword Emperor's Castle?"

"Since you, the young master, have the title of Ron and still played an active role... there must be many people who hope that an alliance between Lun Kandel and Hyran will be formed through this incident."
An alliance between Lun Kandel and Hyran was a topic frequently mentioned among the saints.
At the moment, Zieple was ahead of Lun Kandel, but if Hyran joined Hufester, the gap would be narrowed, and everyone had that expectation.
Of course, it was almost an unrealistic story, but seeing the recent stance of the royal family restraining Hyran and Jin's achievements, it was an uncertain matter.
"It seems to me that there are more people here to see you than me, Murakan."
"I feel that way too."
"Why me?"
"Because you have been the guardian deity of Lun Kandel for the past thousand years and showed quite a remarkable prestige in Hyran. Don't keep making that lazy expression, just smile and be nice."
"Why should I?"
Despite his response, Murakan waved his hand and smiled, which caused even more enthusiastic cheers from the residents.
Then a man wearing glasses approached the party with the guardian knights.
It was Petro, the first-class butler.
"You've arrived, young master!"
"It's been a long time since you've greeted me so calmly."

As he said, Petro usually frantically looked for Jin when he arrived. Jin mostly caused trouble or visited the Sword Garden after damaging the family's reputation, and there were always people trying to take advantage of him at that time.

This time, Jin had also returned after causing trouble. Although the situation was as it was, he provided excessive help to Hyran. He even managed to fend off a suspicious person believed to be a Black Knight.
"So there are no swordsmen waiting to sharpen their blades on me this time?"
"It's not that there aren't any, but there are significantly fewer cases of people openly showing hostility towards you, like before."
"That's good to hear."
"However, a guest came earlier, young master."
"Who is it?"
"It's the Ghost Captain Rata Prochi. He came to the Sword Garden without any notice, saying that he must meet you, young master. He even brought armed mercenaries with him without any fear..."
Petro sighed as he spoke.
